title: VCO • author’s route objectives
note: Primary author reference, labelled 25 September 2026 and rechecked 30 September. The Elspeth Immortal Empires lists supply the objectives here. The public guide uses route numbers, not her in-game narrative titles. This atlas’s subtitles are its own strategic themes. The guide does not expose Route III’s exact search trigger or the precise treaty test for diplomatic control.

title: VCO • Workshop setup
note: Enable VCO before starting a campaign and keep it active. Completing one route is a campaign victory; completing all three is an optional continuation. The atlas is a manual reference, not a mod or a save-game reader.

title: VCO • 9.0 compatibility & reward fix
note: 6.8.4, 27 September 2026, fixes missing victory rewards. The author specifies loading before the victory trigger for an affected existing campaign; the fix is not retroactive. 6.8.1 notes vanilla objectives run alongside VCO under 9.0. Do not merge the two checklists.

title: Creative Assembly • Elspeth & Empire mechanics
note: Primary design reference: Imperial Gunnery School, Field Testing, Amethyst units, Gardens in visible friendly/neutral Empire-owned settlements, and Elspeth-only fast travel. Also distinguishes all-Empire Imperial Authority from Karl Franz’s Elector Counts / Fealty / Decrees.

title: Creative Assembly • update 9.0
note: The update includes revised Warrior Priest and Arch Lector skill trees. The Priest reference has been rebuilt around the updated extracted tree; Arch Lectors are not required by this guide.

title: Gunnery School • field tests & upgrades
note: Community transcription of Field Testing and upgrade panels, not a live 9.0 test. Useful for names and baseline gates; displayed in-game requirements, costs and counters take precedence. No claim that Smart Autoresolve activates abilities or credits every mission.

title: Gardens of Morr • branches & travel
note: Community reference for Black Tower, Militia, Temple and College. It reports a discrepancy between the displayed five-Garden limit and actual construction. This atlas does not depend on unlimited Gardens, and does not claim five is a verified hard cap in every build. Use the live capacity and cooldown.

title: Theodore • Trials by Combat
note: The final quest follows The Countess’ Champion and asks for 1,000 kills by melee cavalry or Demigryph units. Do not substitute general army kills or assume autoresolve events count without checking.

title: Theodore • The Countess’ Champion
note: Recruitment-chain reference. Construct the required Livery, then follow Trials by Combat. A Captain is the temporary army substitute; Theodore is a unique hero, not a repeatable recruit.
